# Scroll area > Scroll container with overlay or space-reserving scrollbars, edge fades, and optional progressive blur. This file matches the installed `scroll-area` source. The online docs follow the latest release and may describe a newer version. ## Install ```bash npx shadcn@latest add https://control-ui.dev/r/scroll-area.json ``` With `@ctrl-ui/react` instead of the registry, import from `@ctrl-ui/react/` where this file says `@/components/control-ui/`; this file then lives at `node_modules/@ctrl-ui/react/dist/docs/scroll-area.md`. ## npm dependencies - `@base-ui/react@^1.9.0` ## Registry dependencies - `core` - `progressive-blur` ## Exports - `@/components/control-ui/knob-contracts/scroll-area-knobs`: `scrollAreaKnobs`, types `ScrollAreaKnobStyle` - `@/components/control-ui/ui/scroll-area`: `scrollAreaScrollbarVisibilities`, `scrollAreaScrollbarGutters`, `ScrollArea`, types `ScrollAreaScrollbarVisibility`, `ScrollAreaScrollbarGutter`, `ScrollAreaLockAxis`, `ScrollAreaViewportProps`, `ScrollAreaProps` ## Composition ### Scrollable content ```tsx scrollable content ``` ## Usage ```tsx "use client"; import { useState } from "react"; import { Button } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/button"; import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/card"; import { ScrollArea } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/scroll-area"; import { Toggle } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/toggle"; import { Text } from "@/components/control-ui/ui/typography"; const changelog = [ "Streamed the first tokens back to the client.", "Resolved the tool call against the registry.", "Normalized the attachment into plain markdown.", "Grouped the reasoning steps by intent.", "Checked each candidate against the contract.", "Kept the smallest change that satisfied all of them.", "Re-ran the validator on the generated fixture.", "Mirrored the manifest into the public registry.", "Synced the installed fixture from the Control UI source.", "Measured the panel height for the open animation.", "Faded the scroll edges that actually clip content.", "Committed the result and moved to the next turn.", ]; export function PrimitiveScrollAreaExample() { return (

Selector pattern: `[data-skin="{skin}"] :where([data-slot="{part}"][data-control-family="{family}"])`. - `scroll-area` - `content`: `data-has-overflow-x`, `data-has-overflow-y`, `data-overflow-x-end`, `data-overflow-x-start`, `data-overflow-y-end`, `data-overflow-y-start`, `data-scrolling` - `corner` - `root`: `data-blur`, `data-has-overflow-x`, `data-has-overflow-y`, `data-lock-axis` (`both` | `x` | `y`), `data-mask`, `data-overflow-x-end`, `data-overflow-x-start`, `data-overflow-y-end`, `data-overflow-y-start`, `data-scrollbar-gutter` (`auto` | `stable`), `data-scrolling` - `scrollbar`: `data-has-overflow-x`, `data-has-overflow-y`, `data-hovering`, `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-overflow-x-end`, `data-overflow-x-start`, `data-overflow-y-end`, `data-overflow-y-start`, `data-scrolling`, `data-visibility` (`always` | `hover` | `scroll`) - `thumb`: `data-orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`), `data-scrolling` - `viewport`: `data-has-overflow-x`, `data-has-overflow-y`, `data-overflow-x-end`, `data-overflow-x-start`, `data-overflow-y-end`, `data-overflow-y-start`, `data-scroll-area-viewport`, `data-scrolling` ## Knobs Registered `--cui-*` custom properties with their recipe defaults. Set them through the component's `style` prop or a skin. ### scroll-area - `--cui-scroll-area-scrollbar-size`: `calc(var(--spacing) * 1.5)` - `--cui-scroll-area-thumb-radius`: `9999px` - `--cui-scroll-area-thumb-background`: `oklch(from var(--foreground) l c h / 0.4)` - `--cui-scroll-area-corner-background`: `transparent` ## Links - Online docs (latest release): https://control-ui.dev/components/scroll-area - Anatomy contract: https://control-ui.dev/r/contract/scroll-area.json
